$comment: Maker and tyre logos of the 2012-2018 DTM, for tools/logo_art.py (assets/engines, assets/tyre). commons = logo file on Wikimedia Commons (licence recorded). Maker logos are the period emblems alone, as on the cars and TV graphics: chrome Audi rings, the BMW roundel and the chrome Mercedes star. team_content sizes them as team list icons (a season's "team_tiles": "maker") in the proportions of the 2012-2013 TV timing graphic: rings 97 px wide, roundel 48, star 55.

Audi.note: the chrome rings, as on the cars in 2012 and 2013 (the 2009 update changed the wordmark, which is cut off here); this file's rings are bright on dark screens, unlike the shadowed 'Audi logo detail.svg'

BMW.note: the chrome-edged roundel of 1997-2020. As a list icon it is larger than on TV (600, not 425): its black outer ring disappears on the game's dark list, so only the blue and white centre reads

Mercedes-Benz.author: Khaled
Mercedes-Benz.note: the chrome star in its ring, as on the cars and TV graphics (no plate, no wordmark)

Hankook.period: flame and wordmark as raced in the 2013 DTM; slogan driving emotion
Hankook.note: flame over the wordmark, without the slogan: the game shows the tyre logo in a small square, where the wide logo was a thin strip
